name: NPC speech lab test
description: Lab driver for Kiln.Npcs (docs/kiln/services/npc-speech.md): the console command npcspeech-test say|replace|suppress|clear|stop|status <entity> runs one call and replies with its result; tools/nettest/npcspeechtest.py checks what Kiln peers are sent on kiln:npcspeech and that a vanilla peer gets nothing.
